public_rationale: Fukushima's foundational contribution and Zhang's 1988 use of backpropagation have documentary support. The retrieved Zhang text is explicitly an English translation, which does not establish that the original Japanese publication included an English abstract. Comparing it with a 1989 LeCun paper also does not settle the date of LeCun's earliest qualifying work. These gaps prevent a supported or contradicted judgment on the complete claim.
limitations: Publication priority and experimental priority may produce different readings of beat LeCun.
The Zhang evidence relies on a translated reproduction rather than a fully readable original proceedings entry.
Month-end and year-end available_at values are conservative availability bounds for historical publications, not asserted exact publication days.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Fukushima did the foundational CNN work in 1979-1980, and Zhang et al applied back-propagation to CNNs in 1988, before LeCun.

statement.excerpt: The foundational work was done by Kunihiko Fukushima in 1979-1980; Wei Zhang et al (1988) beat LeCun to adding the back-propagation to convolutional neural networks in little-known work in 1988 that was published in Japanese (with an English abstract).
statement.document_title: The False Glorification of Yann LeCun

from_speaker: foundational work was done by Kunihiko Fukushima in 1979-1980
Wei Zhang et al (1988) beat LeCun
adding the back-propagation to convolutional neural networks
our_interpretation: Foundational work means an earlier architecture containing central CNN features, not every feature of later CNNs.
Zhang's network must actually use backpropagation for its shared spatial connections.
The comparison must consider LeCun's earliest qualifying work, not assume that his better-known 1989 publication marks the first experiment.
The original publication's language and English abstract are separate factual commitments; a later English translation does not establish an original English abstract.
criteria.support_condition: The records establish Fukushima's foundational 1979–1980 work, Zhang's qualifying 1988 publication in Japanese with an English abstract, and priority over LeCun's corresponding work.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable records contradict a stated date, technical contribution, publication-language detail, or the asserted priority over LeCun.
